key_requirements: Purpose limitation, notice & consent, data subject rights, security measures
retention_period: Art. 11(3): delete/cease processing when specific purpose no longer exists or period expires, unless needed for duties/business or written consent
enforcement_authority: Industry central competent authorities (PDPC not yet established)
penalties_range: Up to NT$1M fine and 5 years prison; admin fines up to NT$500k
exemptions: Personal or household activities; statutory duties
deceased_data: Not covered: living natural persons only (Ministry of Justice interpretation 10503502210, 2016); data of living relatives in records of the dead still protected
research_exemption: Government agencies and academic institutions may process data for statistics or academic research (healthcare, public health, crime prevention) if de-identified (arts. 6(1)(4), 16, 19, 20)
genetic_data: Special category: genetic data among the sensitive categories of art. 6, processing prohibited unless a listed exception applies
notes: Renamed 1995 Act; 2025-11-11 amendment (PDPC) awaits Executive Yuan start date
